seo_description: Solo horror prototype built in 8 weeks in Unreal Engine 5. Pause freezes the enemy but makes it permanently faster.
hero.title: Pause & Deserve
hero.subtitle: Horror Game / Unreal Engine 5 / Pause Mechanic, MetaSounds, 3D Audio
about.text: Solo horror prototype built in 8 weeks to learn Unreal. You can pause to freeze the enemy, but each use makes it permanently faster. Safety now means harder later. I did everything: code, audio, level design. Forest ambience, ticking clock on pause, HRTF spatial audio. Library music, MetaSounds and Sound Cues for SFX.
video.title: Gameplay
approach.title: Approach
approach.pause_desc: Freezes enemy for 5 seconds. Cost: +20% permanent speed, up to 2.5x normal.
approach.ambience_desc: Rustling grass, cracking branches, wind. Random paranoia sounds keep you guessing.
approach.spatial_desc: UE5 HRTF plugin. Footsteps and forest sounds feel like they surround you.
approach.learned_desc: Simple, quality samples beat complex synthesis. Solid foley carried the atmosphere.
